items: Definition Alert: The geographic grid is specifically formed by intersecting lines of latitude and longitude.
Function Alert: The geographic grid is used to determine the exact location of any place via coordinates.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The geographic grid is defined as the network formed by the intersection of lines of latitude and longitude.
It serves the essential function of pinpointing precise spatial locations across the globe.
Coordinates derived from this grid system enable the exact positioning of any place on Earth.
